title: Mermaid examples
brief: Flowchart, sequence diagram, and structured diagram examples.
content:
## Workflow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Idea] --> B[Review]
  B --> C[Build]
```

## Agent handoff

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  User->>Agent: Review complete
  Agent->>Service: Get changes
  Service-->>Agent: Diff
  Agent-->>User: Build result
```

Ordinary code stays unchanged.
